The reading order generally follows the source document. The header information (State, ID, Date) and the title are placed at the beginning. The 'Note' regarding ADA, which is visually at the bottom of the source, has been moved to the top of the document after the header. This is a common and acceptable practice for accessibility to provide contextual disclaimers early. The main content sections follow the exact order of the source.
The bulleted list under 'Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities' is correctly identified as an unordered list containing four distinct items. Each item accurately captures the text from the source.
The source document contains no hyperlinks or URLs. No links were injected into the output JSON.
